intro: Once on, the AI reads members' conversations with AI teammates inside this board's challenges every night, shows the class-wide picture under “Data › Learning analysis”, and lets each member see their own under “My learning insights”.

knowledgePoint.hint: Shared by every challenge; when you edit a challenge the AI suggests against this list
knowledgePoint.removeBody: New challenges can no longer pick it, and challenges already grouped under it stop counting towards the analysis.
knowledgePoint.title: Knowledge points

notice.cardHint: Shown once, the first time a member enters this board; the only button is “I have read and understood”
notice.lead: Welcome. This board has learning analysis on, and every member is included: the AI reads your conversations with AI teammates inside this board's challenges to find the knowledge points you don't yet understand.
notice.pointEvidence: You can see your own analysis, and which sentence each judgement rests on, under “My learning insights”.
notice.pointGroups: A group with fewer than 3 people is not analysed; it just says “fewer than 3, not analysed”.
notice.pointLeaving: After you leave this board, no new conversations are analysed; records already made are kept.
notice.pointOtherRooms: Your conversations in other boards and in private chats are not read.
notice.pointTeacher: The board's admins (teachers) see only the class-wide picture under “Learning analysis”, not your individual analysis or weak points; the dialogue excerpts they see carry only a code, with names and student numbers removed.
notice.title: This board has learning analysis on

privacy.fixed: These three are platform rules; a board cannot change them.
privacy.title: Privacy rules

switchHint: Once on, every member is included, including those who join later
